Name: Mushroom Suite
Author: Dundy03
Description:
Have you ever wanted more mushrooms? Well, you should try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8039]Pacific Northwest Mushrooms[/url]﻿ by pHScale. It adds a bunch of really cool mushrooms.




What's that, you want [i]more [/i]mushrooms? [i]And [/i]you like looking at terrible pixel art? Then Sweet Yoba's Third Armpit do I have the mod for you. Introducing... the Mushroom Suite (patent pending)! Featuring at least nine mushrooms (more to come!) to fungify your Stardew Valley experience! Ever wanted to brew mushrooms into delectable alcoholic drinks? Well, now you can! All this and more* with the Mushroom Suite!

[size=1]*there's not really any more at the moment :(

[/size][size=2]*Spoiler* [b]Mushroom Locations:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

Bay Bolete: Cindersap Forest and Secret Woods in Spring, Summer, and Fall
Caesar's Mushroom: Cindersap Forest and Secret Woods in Summer, and Fall
Death Cap: Cindersap Forest and Secret Woods in Summer, and Fall
Blewit: Cindersap Forest and Secret Woods in all seasons
Scarlet Waxcap: Cidnersap Forest and Secret Woods in Winter
Plump Helmet: Mine Entrance in all seasons
Void Shroom: Witch's Swamp in all seasons
Montagnea: Desert in all seasons
False Earthstar: Desert in all seasons

[/spoiler]

*Spoiler* [b]Other Item Locations:
[/b][spoiler]
Dwarven Keg: Recipe can be purchased from the Dwarf. Requires 10 Gold Bars, 15 Hardwood, and 3 Plump Helmets.
[/spoiler]

[size=2]Mushrooms from this mod and the base game (including truffles!) can also be brewed into Mushroom Wine. Some mushrooms can even be brewed into Dwarven Wine, perfected by the dwarves in their subterranean homes ages ago. Poisonous mushrooms can also be brewed into wine if that's your kinda thing, but I wouldn't drink it at a party... or at all, to be honest.

As of Version 1.1, all of this can now be accomplished at the all-new Dwarven Keg! Unlock the brewing secrets of a lost race, then exploit a rich cultural legacy for massive profit! 
[/size]

[size=2]Potentially compatible with other mods' mushrooms so long as they have the "mushroom_item" tag. Incidentally, that also means these mushrooms can be dried using Artisan valley's Drying Rack! If you see a mod that adds mushrooms that don't work, let me know and I'll add compatibility manually.


[/size]

[size=2][b]Planned Features:[/b][/size]

[size=2]More shrooms! I WANT MORE MUSHROOMS!!! WOOOOOOOO![/size]

[size=2]Mushroom fish!!! Commit a sin against nature and brew living beings into alcohol![/size]
[size=1]


[/size][b]Install Instructions:[/b]

1) Download SMAPI
2) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod
[/url]3) ???
4) Mush away

[b]Updating Mid-Game:

[/b]This is just a content pack, so in theory it's possible. Still, some of the items added by this mod that are present in your save might break or disappear if you update, as items might be renamed or switched around.

[b]Not satisfied? Want MORE mushrooms?!!!! You madman... no one should have this much power... alright, but I warned you...
[/b]Check out these mods for more [b]GLORIOUS [/b]mushrooms:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8039]Pacific Northwest Mushrooms[/url] by pHscale
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13547]False Morel[/url] by pitytheviolins
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13848]Candy Cap Mushroom Cooking[/url] by StarAmy


Changelog:

[spoiler]

1.1: Mushrooms from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8039]Pacific Northwest Mushrooms[/url]﻿ are now brewable. Made some minor sprite changes. Three new mushrooms have been added. All Mushroom Wine brewing is now done using the new Dwarven Keg. Renamed "Void Shroom" to "Void Cap".
1.05: Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256]Raffadax Complete Production[/url]
1.0: Mod released

[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description:
UPDATE 1.1!!!!!

Fixed some sprites around, added 3 new shrooms, as well as compatibility with the wonderful Pacific Northwest Mushrooms mod. Oh, and now mushroom wine has its own keg!
